Since this functions as a second-price auction (I pay the second-highest bid, not my own bid, if I win), the dominant strategy is to bid my true value. This auction functions as a second-price sealed-bid auction: my sealed bid sets my exit point in the ascending clock, and I'll pay the second-highest bid if I win. In such mechanisms, bidding my true value is the dominant strategy—it ensures I win whenever my value exceeds the competition's, and I pay only the second-highest bid, never overpaying. Bidding below value risks losing profitable auctions; bidding above value risks losing money. Therefore, I will bid exactly my value of $43.
